s: tabernacle (Tent of Meeting) has part bars (of the tabernacle) (acacia wood, overlaid with gold)
q: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

s: tabernacle (Tent of Meeting) has part veil (blue, purple, scarlet, fine twined linen, with cherubim)
q: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim.

s: tabernacle (Tent of Meeting) has part screen (for the tent door) (work of an embroiderer)
q: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

s: tabernacle (Tent of Meeting) has covering curtains of goats' hair (covering over the tabernacle) (eleven curtains)
q: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

s: tabernacle (Tent of Meeting) has covering tent coverings (of rams' skins and sea cow hides) (rams' skins dyed red, sea cow hides above)
q: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

s: curtains of fine twined linen (tabernacle's ten curtains) has dimensions 28 by 4 cubits (each curtain)
q: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits.

s: curtains of fine twined linen (tabernacle's ten curtains) is joined with fifty gold clasps (two sets of five curtains, blue loops)
q: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

s: curtains of goats' hair (covering over the tabernacle) has dimensions 30 by 4 cubits (each curtain)
q: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain.

s: Oholiab works with wise-hearted men (workers of the sanctuary) (on the sanctuary work)
q: Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding

s: curtains of goats' hair (covering over the tabernacle) is joined with fifty bronze clasps (five and six curtains coupled)
q: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

s: boards (of the tabernacle) has dimensions 10 cubits by 1.5 cubits (each board)
q: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

s: boards (of the tabernacle) has part sockets of silver (two sockets under each board for its two tenons)
q: two sockets under one board for its two tenons

s: boards (of the tabernacle) is overlaid with gold (rings also of gold for the bars)
q: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars

s: boards (of the tabernacle) count twenty on south, twenty on north, eight on west
q: twenty boards for the south side southward.

s: LORD gives wisdom to wise-hearted men (workers of the sanctuary) (wisdom and understanding to do the sanctuary work)
q: in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary

s: Moses called Bezalel (to the work)
q: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man

s: wise-hearted men (workers of the sanctuary) receives offerings from Moses (offerings brought by Israelites for the sanctuary)
q: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary

s: children of Israel brings offerings (for the sanctuary work) (free will offerings every morning)
q: They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

s: offerings (for the sanctuary work) quantity more than enough (sufficient for all the work, and too much)
q: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.

s: children of Israel is restrained from bringing offerings (by Moses' proclamation)
q: So the people were restrained from bringing.

s: tabernacle (Tent of Meeting) made by wise-hearted men (workers of the sanctuary)
q: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains

s: Bezalel makes ark
q: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood.

s: Bezalel makes anointing oil (holy)
q: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

s: Bezalel makes incense (pure, of sweet spices)
q: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

s: Bezalel makes mercy seat (of pure gold)
q: He made a mercy seat of pure gold.

s: Bezalel makes cherubim (two, of beaten gold)
q: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:

s: Bezalel makes table
q: He made the table of acacia wood.

s: Bezalel makes vessels (of pure gold)
q: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

s: Bezalel makes lamp stand (of pure gold, beaten work)
q: He made the lamp stand of pure gold.

s: Bezalel makes lamps (seven)
q: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

s: Bezalel makes snuffers and snuff dishes (of pure gold)
q: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

s: Bezalel makes altar of incense (of acacia wood)
q: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood.

s: altar of burnt offering made of acacia wood (overlaid with bronze)
q: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood.

s: altar of burnt offering has part vessels (pots, shovels, basins, forks, fire pans, all of bronze)
q: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans.

s: altar of burnt offering is construction hollow with planks
q: He made it hollow with planks.

s: basin (basin and its base) made of mirrors (basin and its base of bronze)
q: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

s: ministering women ministers at Tent of Meeting (at the door)
q: the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

s: court (around the tabernacle) has hangings material fine twined linen
q: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

s: court (around the tabernacle) has south side length one hundred cubits (twenty pillars and twenty bronze sockets)
q: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;

s: court (around the tabernacle) has north side length one hundred cubits (twenty pillars and twenty bronze sockets)
q: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze;

s: court (around the tabernacle) has west side length fifty cubits (ten pillars and ten sockets)
q: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten;

s: court (around the tabernacle) has east side length fifty cubits (gate in the middle, fifteen-cubit hangings on each side)
q: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,

s: altar of burnt offering has shape square
q: It was square.

s: court (around the tabernacle) has part screen for the gate of the court
q: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer

s: court (around the tabernacle) has pillar sockets material bronze
q: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze.

s: court (around the tabernacle) has pillar hooks material silver (hooks and fillets; capitals overlaid with silver)
q: The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver.

s: tabernacle (Tent of Meeting) also called Tabernacle of the Testimony
q: even the Tabernacle of the Testimony

s: tabernacle (Tent of Meeting) has pins material bronze
q: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

s: tabernacle (Tent of Meeting) has materials counted by Ithamar (for the service of the Levites, according to Moses' commandment)
q: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

s: altar of burnt offering has length five cubits
q: Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

s: Ithamar child of Aaron (son)
q: Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

s: Aaron is a priest
q: Aaron the priest.

s: Bezalel child of Uri (son)
q: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah

s: Bezalel belongs to tribe Judah
q: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah

s: Bezalel makes tabernacle (Tent of Meeting) (all that the LORD commanded Moses)
q: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

s: Oholiab child of Ahisamach (son)
q: Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan

s: Oholiab belongs to tribe Dan
q: Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan

s: Oholiab is a engraver (also skillful workman and embroiderer in blue, purple, scarlet, and fine linen)
q: an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.
